programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Frankie Dunlop & John Ore
programme.sub-title: Thelonious Monk live in Palais des Beaux-Arts
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Monk's Dream, Epistrophy and Rhythm-a-Ning.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, John Ore & Frankie Dunlop
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Evidence and Bright Mississippi.

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Paco de Lucía
programme.sub-title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía & Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival. However, the similarities between flamenco and blues have been well documented: both are the outlet for a poor, disenfranchised minority, with a primitive strength, boundless capabilities for improvisation and a requirement for breathtaking virtuosity - all qualities shown by Paco de Lucía in this performance. Moreover, he has long been experimenting with jazz forms (evident even from his inclusion of bass, drums, and saxophone in his sextet), while still retaining the essence of the flamenco tradition. In his own words: “What I have tried to do is have a hand holding onto tradition and the other scratching, digging in other places trying to find new things I can bring into flamenco”.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Stochelo Rosenberg & Peter Beets
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django's music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Art Blakey
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Manu Dibango, Daniel Rallo, Jerry Malekani & Frederic Gaillardet
programme.sub-title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa's biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him. A superb stage performer with great communicative humour, Dibango is above all one of the founding fathers of a modern African musical style that is open to jazz, R&B, salsa, gospel, funk, and reggae. This concert showcases all these genres, and features an excellent line-up of musicians from the four corners of the planet.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.desc: Have you ever wanted to just escape everything and teleport yourself to an uncharted, idyllic tropical island paradise and relax there all day? Now you can do just that with this one hour long high definition nature experience which slowly transports the viewer around two different remote islands hidden in the south Pacific. During the film, viewers will serenely adventure to four of the most famous destinations in South Korea: Jeju Island, Seoul City, Geoje National Park, and Busan.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Frankie Dunlop & John Ore
programme.sub-title: Thelonious Monk live in Palais des Beaux-Arts
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Monk's Dream, Epistrophy and Rhythm-a-Ning.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, John Ore & Frankie Dunlop
programme.desc: Thelonious Monk: Live in '65 features an intimate concert filmed in Belgium in the winter of 1965 with a legendary quartet that includes drummer Frankie Dunlop, bassist John Ore and tenor saxophonist Charlie Rouse. Thelonious Monk revolutionized jazz with his innovative musical approach and these remarkable performances allow viewers the rare opportunity to experience Monk's genius up close as he performs his classic compositions Evidence and Bright Mississippi.

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Paco de Lucía
programme.sub-title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía & Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival. However, the similarities between flamenco and blues have been well documented: both are the outlet for a poor, disenfranchised minority, with a primitive strength, boundless capabilities for improvisation and a requirement for breathtaking virtuosity - all qualities shown by Paco de Lucía in this performance. Moreover, he has long been experimenting with jazz forms (evident even from his inclusion of bass, drums, and saxophone in his sextet), while still retaining the essence of the flamenco tradition. In his own words: “What I have tried to do is have a hand holding onto tradition and the other scratching, digging in other places trying to find new things I can bring into flamenco”.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Stochelo Rosenberg & Peter Beets
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django's music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Art Blakey
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Manu Dibango, Daniel Rallo, Jerry Malekani & Frederic Gaillardet
programme.sub-title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa's biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him. A superb stage performer with great communicative humour, Dibango is above all one of the founding fathers of a modern African musical style that is open to jazz, R&B, salsa, gospel, funk, and reggae. This concert showcases all these genres, and features an excellent line-up of musicians from the four corners of the planet.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass", "Euphoria", ''Mile High" and many more…

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Black death (Garra negra)

El objetivo de su viaje es encontrar a una persona que puede devolver la vida a los muertos. programme.title: El cielo protector
programme.desc: 1947. Una pareja de neoyorquinos viaja a África en busca de nuevas experiencias que puedan dar un nuevo sentido a su relación. En compañía de un joven y rico compañero de viaje, George Tunner, se adentran en el Sáhara en busca de un lugar del que han oído contar cierta leyenda árabe. A medida que huyen de sí mismos y de la civilización, se producen misteriosos acontecimientos que cambiarán sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Diarios de Motocicleta
programme.desc: En 1952, dos jóvenes argentinos, Ernesto Guevara y Alberto Granado, emprenden un viaje por carretera para descubrir la verdadera América Latina. Los dos amigos dejan Buenos Aires en una desvencijada motocicleta Norton de 500cc del año 1939, llevados por un romántico espíritu aventurero. Sus experiencias harán despertar en ellos a los hombres en que se convertirán en el futuro y que definirán sus vidas.

programme.title: Una nueva vida
programme.desc: Tras perder a su esposa, Bill y su hijo comienzan de nuevo en California con ayuda de dos mujeres.

programme.title: V.O.S
programme.desc: Un juego entre dos parejas, entre cuatro personajes. Cuatro visiones de una misma historia.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: El Furgón
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un accidente de tráfico, tres delincuentes escapan del furgón policial.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un golpe en la cabeza, un periodista de Chicago pierde la memoria y emprende un largo viaje.

programme.title: Charada
programme.desc: Tras unos días de esquí, Regina vuelve a Parías con la idea de pedir el divorcio. Cuando llega su casa está desvalijada y su esposo asesinado. A ella la acosarán los asesinos que quieren saber dónde escondió su marido una importante fortuna.

programme.title: Ámsterdam
programme.desc: Un misterio épico sobre una sorprendente trama secreta de la historia de EE. UU.

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: In the Loop
programme.desc: El Presidente de EE.UU. y el Primer Ministro británico deciden iniciar una guerra y prometen ser rápidos. El Secretario de Estado británico para el desarrollo internacional, respalda accidentalmente la acción militar en horario de máxima audiencia en televisión, ganando muchos amigos en Washington.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: Cuando de trata de romance, Patrick dempsey cumple en esta loca comedia. Mientras trabaja como repartidor de pizza para pagar sus estudios, dempsey aprende algunas lecciones sobre el amor de amas de casa aburridas que buscan más que anchoas en sus pizzas.

programme.title: Un Diploma Muy Caro
programme.desc: John Plummer (Jason Lee) es un hombre trabajador como cualquier otro que está a punto de casarse con su novia desde hace muchos años, Elaine (Leslie Mann), ahora que han ahorrado 30 000 dólares para el pago inicial de la casa de sus sueños. Pero, años antes, John hizo la olvidada promesa de pagar la matrícula de su sobrina Noreen (Tammy Blanchard) si entraba a una buena universidad. Milagrosamente, Noreen fue aceptada nada más y nada menos que en la Universidad de Harvard, y ahora lo único que necesita de su tío John son otros 29 879 dólares para su matrícula. Como no puede decirle a Elaine que necesita ganar 30 000 dólares adicionales en dos semanas, John recurre a su amigo Duff (Tom Green), quien lo convence de involucrarse por un corto tiempo en delitos menores. La vida de John rápidamente se derrumba cuando cada uno de los alocados timos de Duff se sale de control.

programme.title: Pesadillas
programme.desc: Zach Cooper descubre el lado positivo de mudarse a un pueblo pequeño cuando conoce a su vecina Hannah, la hija de R. L. Stine, el célebre escritor de la serie Pesadillas. Stine es un hombre misterioso que vive prisionero de su propia imaginación, ya que los monstruos que sus libros hicieron famosos resultan ser reales y debe mantenerlos encerrados en sus manuscritos para proteger a sus lectores. Cuando los monstruos se liberan accidentalmente y comienzan a sembrar el terror en el pueblo, dependerá de Stine, Zach y Hannah hacer que regresen a los libros a los que pertenecen.

programme.title: En qué piensan los hombres
programme.desc: Cuatro amigos conspiran para revertir la situación con sus mujeres cuando descubren que han estado usando los consejos sobre relaciones de Steve Harvey contra ellos.

programme.title: El tesoro del lago de plata
programme.desc: Tras el asalto a una diligencia y el asesinato de su padre, Fred Engel se une a Old Shatterhand y Winnetou para recuperar un mapa del tesoro dividido en dos. Su búsqueda los lleva hasta Silver Lake, donde deberán adelantarse a la banda del coronel Brinkley, decidida a hacerse con el oro.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 25, 26, 27
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Guerrero cheyenne
programme.desc: En su viaje hacia Oregón, Matthew y Rebecca se detienen en un puesto fronterizo donde un malentendido con los Cheyenne desencadena una tragedia. Rebecca y un guerrero herido, Hawk, son los únicos supervivientes. Con el invierno acercándose, ambos deberán superar sus diferencias para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres se adentran en el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: Un extraño en la boda de mi hermano
programme.desc: April Monroe, exitosa doctora, se enamora de Jesse, pero desconoce su pasado amish. Cuando viajan a la región amish por la boda de su hermano, deben enfrentarse a secretos familiares y prejuicios, poniendo a prueba su amor y su relación frente al caos y la tradición.

programme.title: Not Forgotten
programme.desc: En un pueblo fronterizo de Tex-Mex, un hombre y su mujer deben enfrentarse a sus torturados pasados para salvar a su hija secuestrada.

programme.title: Un deseo en Nashville
programme.desc: Un joven cantante de country sueña con llegar a Nashville y conquistar a la animadora más guapa del instituto. Cuando su carrera empieza a despegar al mismo tiempo que su relación, debe elegir entre la música y el amor en una historia sobre el primer romance, el destino y el paso a la madurez.

programme.title: La Guarida del Lobo
programme.desc: Vicente ha sido herido y Toco lo acoge en su cabaña. El cambio en la pacífica relación que mantenían es provocado por un personaje que quiere las tierras de Toco. Pronto se desata el conflicto y se revelan secretos inesperados.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Madame
programme.desc: Anne y Bob, una pareja americana que vive en París, organizan una cena e invitan a diez amigos. El hijo de Bob llega por sorpresa y el número total de invitados es ahora de 13. La supersticiosa Anne le pide a su criada, María, que pretenda ser un rico amigo español y se unan a la mesa. María conoce a David, un aristócrata británico. Ambos se gustan y continuarán su relación.

programme.title: Animales Heridos
programme.desc: Historias que se cruzan sobre parejas, la soledad y las heridas del amor.

programme.title: Mi gran despedida
programme.desc: Tres amores: el de Puri, dispuesta a hacer lo posible y lo imposible por dejar las cosas claras con su novio el de Milagro, que guarda más secretos de los que su naturaleza le permite, y el de Sara, cuya inminente boda reúne a un variopinto grupo de mujeres para festejar su compromiso.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: Cause For Alarm
programme.desc: An invalid husband wrongly believes his wife and doctor are conspiring to kill him and outlines that suspicion in a letter, which causes a serious concern when he ends up dying anyway.

programme.title: Antrum: The Deadliest Film Ever Made
programme.desc: A young boy and girl enter the forest to dig a hole to hell. Said to be a cursed film from the late 1970s, Antrum examines the horrifying power of storytelling.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: After investigating inside a neighbors attic, two high school friends, known for making prank videos, are increasingly plagued by a series of disturbing, supernatural events involving a creepy, vintage doll named Heidi - but no one will take their claims seriously, until it is too late.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: El agresor
programme.desc: David Sloan debe viajar a México para salvar a su mujer de un salvaje narcotraficante, que además es un viejo némesis.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Es el Blitz de Londres en 1940. Un anciano y enfermo Dr. John Watson cuenta a su enfermera la historia de su investigación más compleja con Sherlock Holmes, que ambos juraron que nunca se contaría al público ni se adaptaría a una de las famosas historias de Watson.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Un mensajero de Nueva York (Taylor Lautner) se ve envuelto en una trama criminal. 'Tracers' está ambientada en el espectacular mundo del parkour, una técnica de desplazamiento en la que hay que superar todos los obstáculos usando las habilidades del cuerpo humano: saltando vallas, muros, etc.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: Joshua McCord es un agente del servicio secreto retirado al que le encargan la misión de entrenar a un joven. Sin embargo, cuando la Primera Dama es secuestrada por terroristas, se encuentra inmerso en una misión de 'todo o nada'.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Pequeño gran guerrero
programme.desc: Un viejo soldado secuestra a un joven general de un estado enemigo y lo lleva en un largo viaje para conseguir la recompensa.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: Un SEAL acusado injustamente compite contra asesinos para ganar libertad.

programme.title: The Quest: En busca de la ciudad perdida
programme.desc: Un grupo de soldados de fortuna visita una legendaria «ciudad perdida» situada en el Tíbet.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Un sicario novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo.

programme.title: Contrición
programme.desc: Cuando Tara, una mujer con poderes, desaparece, Axe comienza a buscarla.

programme.title: Perdidos En El Sol
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente de poca monta, que encuentra de cómplice a un adolescente huérfano.

programme.title: El Arte De Robar
programme.desc: Crunch Calhoun, un acróbata motociclista de tercera, y ladrón de arte en sus ratos libres, se junta con su escurridizo hermano para robar uno de los libros más valiosos del mundo. Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.

programme.title: Xxx 2: Estado De Emergencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela atiborrada de acción del éxito de taquilla xXx, Ice Cube interpreta a Darius Stone, un liante en busca de subidones cuyos antecedentes policiales y su obsesión por los deportes extremos le convierten en candidato ideal para ser el próximo agente xXx. Debe salvar a Estados Unidos de una conspiración letal del general de cinco estrellas y Secretario de Defensa George Deckert (interpretado por Willem Dafoe). Solo un renegado agente xXx como Stone tiene las habilidades extremas para evitar que el peligroso grupo disidente del ejército tome el gobierno en la capital de Estados Unidos.
